title: Rating Manual Schedule — Cardinal DriveSense Participation Discount, Score Bands and Surcharges
content:
Percentages for Cardinal DriveSense by program. Scores run from 0 to 100, and a higher score is safer driving.

## Schedule 1 — Participation discount and limits

| Program | Participation discount (from enrollment until the earned discount is fixed) | Largest discount a score can earn | Largest surcharge a score can bring where surcharges are permitted | Policy states where a score may bring a surcharge | Most a surcharge may change between consecutive terms |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Mobile | 5% | 25% | 10% | OH, IN, KY, WV | 10% |
| Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In | 5% | 30% | 10% | OH, IN, KY, WV | 10% |
| Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | 7% | 30% | 0% | None | 0% |
| Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach | 10% | 20% | 0% | None | 0% |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile | 0% | 0% | 0% | None | 0% |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | 0% | 0% | 0% | None | 0% |

## Schedule 2 — Earned discount by score band

| Score band | Mobile | Plug-In | Connected Car | Teen Coach |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 90-100 | 25% | 30% | 30% | 20% |
| 80-89 | 15% | 18% | 18% | 12% |
| 70-79 | 8% | 10% | 10% | 6% |
| 60-69 | 3% | 4% | 4% | no band |

Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile and Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In have no score discount bands.

## Schedule 3 — Surcharge by score band (applied below the lowest discount band)

| Score band | Mobile | Plug-In | Connected Car | Teen Coach | Miles Mobile | Miles Plug-In |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 40-59 | 5% | 5% | no band | no band | no band | no band |
| 0-39 | 10% | 10% | no band | no band | no band | no band |

## Notes to the schedules

1. The lowest discount band is 60-69 on Mobile, Plug-In and Connected Car, and 70-79 on Teen Coach. The surcharge bands of Schedule 3 sit below 60 on Mobile and Plug-In.
2. Both end figures of a band are inside the band: on Mobile, a fixed score of 80 and a fixed score of 89 both fall in 80-89 (15%); 79 falls in 70-79 (8%); 90 falls in 90-100 (25%).
3. Where a program shows "no band", the schedule assigns no percentage to scores in that range.
4. The top band of each program equals that program's largest earned discount (25% on Mobile, 30% on Plug-In and Connected Car, 20% on Teen Coach), and the 0-39 surcharge on Mobile and Plug-In equals their 10% largest surcharge.
